en.io: Inputs include an Agent Analytics API key, project name and domain, browser events and properties, query periods, funnel steps, or experiment definitions. Outputs include a project write token and tracking snippet, recorded events, analytical summaries, and experiment probabilities, lift, or recommendations.
en.boundary: The evidence describes one analytics platform and its claimed behavior. It does not independently establish privacy properties, statistical validity, availability, or schema stability; experiments need sufficient exposure, and instrumentation changes still require application access and deployment.
dependencies: AGENT_ANALYTICS_API_KEY or a token supplied during login
Agent Analytics hosted service or a self-hosted deployment
A web application capable of loading the tracker and calling window.aa
scenarios: Create an analytics project and add automatic page-view tracking.
Instrument a small set of high-value custom events.
Inspect traffic, pages, sessions, funnels, retention, and activity times.
Create, read, and complete an A/B experiment.

zh.io: 输入包括 Agent Analytics API 密钥、项目名称与域名、浏览器事件与属性、查询周期、漏斗步骤或实验定义；输出包括项目写入令牌和追踪片段、已记录事件、分析摘要，以及实验概率、提升或建议。
zh.boundary: 证据描述的是特定分析平台及其自述行为，并未独立证明隐私属性、统计有效性、可用性或模式稳定性。实验需要足够曝光量，埋点变更仍需应用访问和部署。
dependencies: AGENT_ANALYTICS_API_KEY 或登录时提供的令牌
Agent Analytics 托管服务或自托管部署
能够加载追踪器并调用 window.aa 的 Web 应用
scenarios: 创建分析项目并添加自动页面浏览追踪。
埋点少量高价值自定义事件。
查看流量、页面、会话、漏斗、留存和活跃时段。
创建、读取和结束 A/B 实验。
